C0152.title: Selling Accounts Lands Man in Prison: Huaiyuan Prosecutor Details Social Media Account Resale Case Under PRC’s “Aiding Cybercrime” Law
C0152.summary: From 2022 to 2024, Defendant A knowingly sold more than 200 social media accounts, including Douyin, QQ, and Kuaishou accounts, to buyers using them for telecom-fraud traffic diversion. One purchased Douyin account led victim Zhao to lose more than 1.8 million yuan. A earned over 30,000 yuan illegally, refunded part of the losses and proceeds, and was convicted of aiding information network criminal activities, receiving a one-year prison term suspended for one year and six months plus an 8,000 yuan fine.
